flags: DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay / seasonal park, tests 1, 2 and 4): the operator's RV Park page markets only '46 Seasonal RV lots with power, water, sewer hook-ups', 'Set up your trailer for the season', 'Seasonal RV lots will go quickly', 'Fill out our application today to be added to our waiting list', 'Application form required for approval', 'Includes Winter Storage'. The only daily camping is 'a daily non-serviced group area'. No nightly rate anywhere on pipestonelinks.com and no booking engine (the only online booking is the tee-time sheet). A web search found no current rate either: the only figures are RV Life camper reports of US$31 from 2008 and 2010. Imagery shows the lots packed with long-parked trailers. Read as mostly seasonal: 0 of 46 serviced lots sold nightly.
